headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty gained 0.5% led by IT and pharma stocks amid weekly rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: IT and pharma stocks rallied in the last trading session providing upward momentum
Reliance Industries saw significant buying interest and foreign inflows
The Nifty Smallcap 100 index jumped 4% during the week, outperforming broader indices
Positive sentiment was bolstered by several Nifty50 stocks delivering over 10% returns in October
whatHappening: SEBI is closely monitoring developments regarding the Tata Group
The Indian government released an additional ₹1.09-trillion tax devolution tranche to states
Crude oil prices have risen above $116 per barrel, contributing to market volatility
Market analysts are predicting a potential Diwali bonanza for bulls in the upcoming trading week
summary: The Indian stock market ended the last session higher, with the Sensex and Nifty gaining 0.5% driven by IT and pharma sectors. Over the past week, major indices rose 2% while smallcap stocks outperformed with a 4% jump. Investors are now looking ahead to the Diwali week as SEBI monitors Tata Group and tax devolution boosts state finances.
